coordinate_frame: Component side, millimetres, X increases left-to-right and Y increases top-to-bottom.

orientation.left: J1 power edge and the three large radial capacitors
orientation.right: ESP32-C6 module, J8, and tach circuitry
orientation.one_line: Hold the component side toward you with C1/C2 at upper-left, J6 at top, and J8 at lower-right.

TP1.location: Far left edge, immediately left of R1/R2 and above D1; left of the upper large capacitor C1.
TP1.expected: Approximately the external 24 V input when powered.

TP2.location: Lower ring of the vertical TP3/TP2 pair just right of C2 and F1, above the tall D2 TVS.
TP2.expected: Approximately 24 V after the input protection stage when powered.

TP3.location: Upper ring of the vertical TP3/TP2 pair just right of C2 and F1.
TP3.expected: Power-ground reference for RAW24, VM24, and high-current measurements.

TP4.location: Large ring on the top edge above C11 and U3; right of TP5.

TP5.location: Large ring on the top edge above C7; left of TP4 and right of C2.
TP5.expected: Approximately 3.3 V when the board is powered.

TP6.location: Lower-right tach area, immediately left of J8 and above C27; beside U9.
TP6.expected: Approximately 12 V when the tach supply is healthy.

TP7.location: Immediately upper-right of U1, below TP12, beside C14 and the R4-R7 pull-up column.
TP7.expected: Approximately 3.3 V when the MCF8316D analog regulator is alive.

TP8.location: Upper ring of the TP8/TP16 pair immediately left of U1, near C15 and R8.
TP8.expected: Approximately 1.5 V when the MCF8316D digital regulator is alive.

TP9.location: Above SW1, immediately right of R3 and below C9/C10.
TP9.expected: High, approximately 3.3 V, when the board rails are healthy.

TP10.location: Bottom ring of the four-ring TP11/TP24/TP27/TP10 column between U1 and U10.
TP10.expected: State-dependent 0 V or 3.3 V safety-latch clear signal; interpret only within a named test state.

TP11.location: Top ring of the four-ring TP11/TP24/TP27/TP10 column immediately right of U1.
TP11.expected: State-dependent 0 V or 3.3 V permission-latch output; interpret only within a named test state.

TP12.location: Immediately upper-right of U1 and directly above TP7, beside R7.
TP12.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while drive is disabled; approximately 0 V only when hardware permits drive.

TP13.location: Upper ring of the TP13/TP14 pair below C20 and left of the ESP module.
TP13.expected: A 0-to-3.3 V heartbeat waveform after the ESP firmware starts.

TP14.location: Lower ring of the TP13/TP14 pair below C20 and above U6.
TP14.expected: High when the external watchdog is satisfied; low when it times out.

TP15.location: Bottom-center safety area above R34, between U10 and U7.
TP15.expected: Normally high; a deliberate low resets the external watchdog.

TP16.location: Lower ring of the TP8/TP16 pair immediately left of U1, above L1.

TP17.location: Second ring in the TP20/TP17/TP18/TP19 column beside R4-R7, right of U1.
TP17.expected: High when the MCF reports no aggregate fault; low during a fault.

TP18.location: Third ring in the TP20/TP17/TP18/TP19 column beside R4-R7, right of U1.
TP18.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while idle, with 0-to-3.3 V I2C activity during MCF transactions.

TP19.location: Bottom ring in the TP20/TP17/TP18/TP19 column beside R4-R7, right of U1.
TP19.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while idle, with 0-to-3.3 V I2C clock activity during MCF transactions.

TP20.location: Top ring in the TP20/TP17/TP18/TP19 column beside R4-R7, right of U1.
TP20.expected: High while stopped; 0-to-3.3 V pulses while the MCF reports rotation.

TP21.location: Unlabelled single ring at the far-right edge in the tach corner, beside R43/Q3 and below TP23.
TP21.expected: 0 V or 3.3 V depending on Hall state; one physical rotor edge per revolution in operation.

TP22.location: Middle-right tach area, left of TP23 and just above C32/R49.
TP22.expected: Speed-dependent analog tach voltage; near its stopped baseline with no Hall edges.

TP23.location: Large labelled ring at the far-right edge beside Q3, above TP21.
TP23.expected: Approximately 2.58 V from the 10.0 kOhm / 35.7 kOhm reference divider.

TP24.location: Unlabelled second ring in the TP11/TP24/TP27/TP10 column immediately right of U1.
TP24.expected: High in the healthy state; low when the analog overspeed comparator trips.

TP25.location: Immediately below and right of J6, beside U12 and R21/R58.
TP25.expected: Approximately half of USB VBUS, nominally 2.5 V with a 5 V USB source.

TP26.location: AGND ring immediately below and left of J6, above R55/R11.
TP26.expected: Convenient local analog/logic ground near USB and the ESP side.

TP27.location: Unlabelled third ring in the TP11/TP24/TP27/TP10 column immediately right of U1.
TP27.expected: Local power-ground reference near the MCF and safety logic.

TP28.location: AGND ring below TP26 and left of J6/U12, beside R11/C19.
TP28.expected: Convenient local analog/logic ground near USB and PGOOD circuitry.

J1.name: POWER
J1.location: Left edge, below C1 and beside Q1.
J1.orientation: Component-side view: pin 1 is the left/outboard contact; pin 2 is the right/inboard contact.
J1.warning: Use TP1/TP3 for probing when possible.

J2.name: MOTOR
J2.location: Bottom edge left of centre, below U1 and the large lower capacitor C6.
J2.orientation: Component-side view, left-to-right: pin 3 U, pin 2 V, pin 1 W.
J2.warning: Never attach a grounded scope lead to U, V, or W. Use a rated differential probe only.

J3.name: HALL
J3.location: Bottom edge right of centre, left of H2/J8.
J3.warning: Prefer TP21 for Hall probing and TP26 for AGND.

J4.name: TEMP
J4.location: Bottom edge near centre, directly below U1.
J4.warning: TEMP_SENSE has no dedicated test point.

J5.name: I2C
J5.location: Top edge left of centre, above U3.
J5.orientation: Component-side view, left-to-right across the board pads: pin 4, pin 3, pin 2, pin 1.

J6.name: USB-C
J6.location: Top edge right of centre, above U12.
J6.orientation: USB-C receptacle; use a cable rather than hand-probing its fine pads.

pins.function: USB data and VBUS sense only

J6.warning: USB VBUS does not power the board. Use TP25 for VBUS_SENSE.

J7.name: PROGRAM
J7.location: Centre-right, between U5/U6 and the ESP module.
J7.orientation: Component-side view: top row 2/4/6, bottom row 1/3/5.
J7.warning: Pin 1 is board 3V3, not a power input. Never let a programmer drive it while 24 V is connected.

J8.name: SCOPE
J8.location: Lower-right edge, immediately right of U9/C27.
J8.orientation: Component-side view: five rows top-to-bottom; odd pins are left/inboard and even pins are right/board-edge.
J8.warning: The 1.27 mm pads are unsuitable for repeated handheld ceiling probing. Populate a header or attach inspected pigtails while fully unpowered.

JP1.name: BUCK MODE/SYNC
JP1.location: Upper-left of centre, directly below U3.
JP1.warning: Configuration strap, not a routine probe location.
